description.value: RayCam Co-operative Centre is a City of Vancouver community centre serving the Strathcona neighbourhood on East Hastings Street. It offers recreational and community programming in one of Vancouver's most historically significant and densely cycled urban corridors. Touring cyclists passing through the area will find public washrooms on site.
